Sam (Partnerships): Quick brainstorm: pilot a 'SI Onramp Day' focused on marketplace listing + private deploys + cert badge. Short, hands-on, 3 hours. Good pickup for small integrators?
Eve (SI Enablement): Yes. Recommend a 20m orientation, 2h labs (3 stations, 40m each), 40m debrief + badge issue. Need proctors and sandbox tenants.
Carlos (DevEx): I can provide starter repo and infra templates. Will also script a preflight check partners run one day prior.
Nora (Marketplace): Sandbox marketplace tenants available but require signing the TOU. We'll need legal confirmation for demo manifests.
Sam (Partnerships): OK volunteers for proctoring? Need 3 internal leads.
Eve (SI Enablement): I'll lead station 2 (private/VPC onboarding). Carlos -> observability station?
Carlos (DevEx): Yup. Nora -> marketplace listing station?
Nora (Marketplace): On it. I'll also prepare a short checklist for listing requirements.
InfraBot: sandbox provisioning template created: redwoodctl sandbox create --name si-onramp-<team>.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items: Carlos -> starter repo + preflight script (due Fri); Eve -> station plans + rubric (due Mon); Nora -> sandbox check + TOU note (due Wed). We'll aim for pilot 2026-05-12.
Eve (SI Enablement): Also recommend issuing a "practice badge" for pilot, full cert later. Keeps bar flexible.
Sam (Partnerships): Agreed. I'll start outreach to 4 potential integrators.
Carlos (DevEx): Recording disabled by default. Partners can opt in.
Nora (Marketplace): I'll confirm legal by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (Partnerships): Great team. Let's sync again Tue for a rehearsal. :rocket:
